title: Classic Pickaxe
body:
-"How can this thing even hit rocks? It's literally just a cube..."-

Description

The Classic Pickaxe is a special pickaxe that was added for Oaklands' second anniversary alongside the Classic Island area, making it easier to reach the Classic Store than it used to be via traveling through the Desert Highlands.

Appearance

The Classic Pickaxe takes appearance of two brick parts with studs on the top and inlets on the bottom, being comprised of colors that seem to be Bright orange and Medium stone grey.

Obtaining

Place a Steel Pickaxe in front of the Noob in the Classic Biome and interact with him to transfer the Steel Pickaxe for a Classic Pickaxe. It has the same stats as the Steel Pickaxe.
